Welcome to Clay County
Official Website of Clay County in Nebraska. Your source for Information about Clay County Offices, Departments and Services.
Cities and villages include: Clay Center, Deweese, Edgar, Fairfield, Glenvil, Harvard, Ong, Saronville, Sutton, Trumbull
